events.title: THE HEWING / THE HEWN THRESHOLD OPENS
events.body: Under user direction, GEEHUB's Interlocutive Domain receives its founding architectural place and executable browser entrance. The threshold is a hand-hewn timber passage whose lintel records actual first encounters and whose posts gather later inscriptions. The static application reads the field registry, exposes participant affordances and capability states, presents the nine-movement crossing method, and stores user-entered inscriptions locally for JSON export. Local browser inscriptions are not remote commits. The architectural description is canon; no physical 3D model is claimed.

events.title: THE AI FOUNDATION ANSWERS / WAND AND TRACTUS SPECIFICATION
events.body: Dropbox inspection returned the complete GEEHUB AI Build 0.1 specification, the supervised Live Wand Session 001 receipt, the Coach Presence Charter, and Dima Romanov's physique study. Build 0.1 defines a Tractus event store, prime-coded record classes, bounded Wand operations, retrieval, a pluggable model adapter, verification and permission gates. It explicitly states that the runtime source tree and provider configuration are not yet implemented. The prior Wand session was supervised and its ledger simulated. These documents are registered as actual field sources; no autonomous AI runtime is claimed.
